svg.text: Hold step pad(s) ~0.2 s: the lower half becomes per-step editing.
Probability of the held step(s) | Set their velocity
While holding: drum pads = probability scale (1/16 ... 16/16), velocity pads = set velocity (adds the note if missing),
Bank UP/DOWN = nudge off the grid (-2 ... +3 clock ticks). Releasing after a hold changes nothing - safe for peeking.
Only quick, unedited taps toggle steps.
